posts.title: The Top 20 Rap Albums of 1996
posts.description: We’re up to the year 1996. After a fairly disappointing 1995, 1996 is much better. Exciting new acts emerged like Jay-Z, Jugganauts, and Eminem, who debuted with his independent “Infinite” album. Yeah, it’s largely forgettable, but still worth noting.
